description: Erection of a side and rear extension to existing detached garage with one large garage door
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Unnumbered design and access statement, Unnumbered location plan, 01-PA R4, 02-PA R4, 02-PA R4. Received 23/02/19  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The hereby approved outbuilding to the rear elevation as shown on the submitted plans shall be fitted with an inward-opening door, an up-and-over door or a similar system prior to the first use of the development and the doors as fitted shall not impede the pedestrian footway when open and shall be retained as such for the duration of the development.
